jobs.title: Software Engineer I, Fullstack (Disputes Platform)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
  
  
Our team owns the refund experience for Affirm customers. We build the customer-facing features, backend services and data foundations that make refunds clear, fast and reliable. Refunds touch a large share of our customers, so the work has a direct, visible impact on their trust in Affirm. We're a growing team with a full roadmap, which means we can invest consistently in this area.
  
  
We're collaborative and ownership-minded. Engineers own their work from design through on-call, raise risks early, and share what they learn. We care about clear written communication and constructive code review, and we work closely with partner teams across the company.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* With the support of your team, you will work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals.
* You will work collaboratively and proactively with your team and stakeholders, bringing them along for your work and helping to create visibility and dialog regarding the risks and trade-offs related to your work.
* You will strike the right balance of speed and quality in your work, ensuring that we hit our business goals while protecting our systems from downtime.
* You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities.

**What We Look For**

* You have previous work or internship experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue.
* You have previous work or internship designing, developing and launching APIs at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
* You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
* You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
* Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
* You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
* This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - J
  
  
Equity Grade - 4
  
  
Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
  
  
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).
  
  
CAN base pay range per year: $101,000 - $151,000 CAD
  
  
Location - Remote Canada. This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.
  
  
LI-Remote
  
  
**Remote-first with flexibility built in**
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.
  
  
**Benefits Designed For You**
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:
  
  

* Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
* Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
* Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
* Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.
  
  
For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.
  
  
By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**A path for every ambition.**
At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. We power progress and protect ambition: for the clients who count on us, and equally for the people who make that possible every day.
  
  
We’re creative thinkers and determined doers, guided by values that show up in how we work together: with empathy, adaptability, accountability and a genuine commitment to one another’s success. We foster bold ideas, celebrate curiosity and share what we know. Because when people grow, the work they do grows with them.
  
  
Our purpose is deeply human: to help people navigate the world on their terms, at their speed, toward their future. We hold that same commitment to the people building careers here.
  
  
Whether you’re starting out or leveling up, you’ll find the resources to evolve, the support to take on more and a team ready to back you at every stage.
  
  
Your ambition has a home here.
  
  
**About The Role**
HUB International's National Employee Benefits & Retirement (EB&R) Digital Delivery & Product Team is seeking a Software Developer to support the development and ongoing enhancement of two proprietary platforms: HART (HUB Automated Renewal Tool) and HIC (HUB Investment Consulting). Both tools are central to how HUB's advisors and consultants deliver renewal automation and investment consulting services to clients across Canada. This role reports to the Manager, Digital Delivery & Product.
  
  
We are looking for a curious, adaptable developer who is comfortable moving between codebases, picks up new tools quickly, and brings enough employee benefits or financial services context to understand the problems they are solving. You will work in an agile environment alongside benefits consultants, investment advisors, and product leads, translating real workflow needs into working software.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Develop and maintain features across both HART and HIC platforms, working across backend, frontend, and data layers depending on team priorities.
* On HART: build and maintain ASP.NET (C# / .NET 8.0) backend services, React/Node.js frontend components, and T-SQL stored procedures against Azure SQL — supporting the end-to-end group benefits renewal automation workflow.
* On HIC: develop and maintain Python-based backend services and Vue.js frontend components, integrating third-party financial data APIs to support investment consulting workflows for Canadian pension and investment funds.
* Write clean, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, sprint planning, and retrospectives in an agile delivery cycle.
* Collaborate with benefits consultants, investment advisors, and product leads to gather requirements and translate them into well-scoped technical solutions.
* Build and maintain Snowflake SQL analytics queries and ETL pipelines (Coalesce.IO) feeding HART's reporting and analytics layers.
* Contribute to Power BI reporting (DAX) and automated PowerPoint generation surfaced through HART.
* Support UiPath RPA workflows, Amazon S3 and Secure FTP file integrations, and multi-environment deployments (Dev, QA/Staging, Prod) via GitHub and Jira.
* Monitor application performance across environments and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
* Learn the employee benefits and investment consulting domain with curiosity — understanding the advisor and client workflows your code supports makes you a better developer on this team.

**What You'll Need For Success**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 1–3 years of hands-on software development experience.
* Proficiency in at least one of C# (.NET) or Python for backend development, with a genuine willingness to work in both.
* Front-end development experience with JavaScript and at least one modern framework (React or Vue.js).
* Solid understanding of relational databases and SQL — writing, reading, and debugging queries and stored procedures.
* Comfort working across multiple layers of an application (backend, frontend, database) rather than specializing in one.
* Experience with Git/GitHub for version control and familiarity with Jira or a similar agile project management tool.
* A fast learner — able to get productive in an unfamiliar codebase or tool without extensive hand-holding.
* Strong communication skills and an ability to work collaboratively with both technical teammates and non-technical business stakeholders.
* Some familiarity with employee benefits, group insurance, pension, or financial services — through work experience, education, or genuine personal interest.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Snowflake SQL and cloud data warehouse or ETL concepts (Coalesce.IO or similar).
* Power BI report development experience, including DAX formula authoring.
* Exposure to RPA platforms, particularly UiPath.
* Experience with cloud file storage (Amazon S3), Secure FTP integrations, or containerization tools (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Familiarity with multi-environment deployment pipelines (Dev / QA / Prod).
* Experience working with third-party financial data APIs.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office: Excel, Word, and Outlook.

**AI Disclosure**
AI and Automation Notice HUB International uses limited AI and automation tools within our recruitment systems to enhance efficiency in the hiring process and in the candidate experience. These tools do not independently make hiring decisions or screen out candidates — all decisions are made through human review
  
  
**What We Offer You**
We invest in your growth. HUB offers structured training, licensing support, and ongoing development opportunities designed to accelerate your career. Benefits and programs vary based on employment status, role, location, and applicable eligibility requirements.
  
  

* Competitive pay with comprehensive health benefits, retirement savings matching, and company-paid life and disability plans
* Generous paid time off, paid parental leave and a wellbeing program designed to support real work/life balance
* A collaborative, high-performing culture with meaningful engagement, community impact through HUB Gives and genuine room to grow your career

**The HUB difference**
HUB International is one of North America’s largest insurance brokers, delivering risk management, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management solutions to businesses and individuals across the United States and Canada — through locally led teams backed by national expertise, giving you the agility of a local partner and the reach of a global organization.
  
  
We endeavor to make this website accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact the recruiting team HUBRecruiting@hubinternational.com. This contact information is for accommodation requests only; do not use this contact information to inquire about the status of applications.
